policies.title: Account deletion runs the erasure function
policies.statement: Every DELETE endpoint must always call delete_user_account, the function that removes a user's personal data. This is part of the right to erasure under GDPR Article 17. The check confirms the call is made; it does not confirm that the function deletes every table holding the user's data. An endpoint that cannot call it must be exempted by the policy owner, not left unchecked.
